REPORT.FORMULA_TITLE: Why are actual bank card charges 15–30% higher than Meta base rates?
REPORT.FORMULA_TEXT: 1) 12% VAT & bank FX conversion: Meta bills in USD at base rates ($0.018 per service/utility message in KZ), while Kazakhstan corporate card charges include 12% VAT and bank USD selling FX spread (+2–4% above the 1st-of-month NBK rate). 2) Per-Message Pricing (PMP) & consecutive replies: once the 1,000 free service messages are used, Meta charges $0.018 for every individual message. Sending 2–3 short consecutive messages instead of a single consolidated reply multiplies the cost.
REPORT.MANAGERS_SUBTITLE: A consecutive message is a service reply sent by the same manager in the same conversation within 5 minutes of their previous message without a customer message in between.
